title: MLBB: Aurora Gaming takes down Team Falcons to clinch MPL Philippines Season 18 crown
summary: Aurora Gaming PH (RORA) claimed the MPL Philippines Season 18 title after dispatching Team Falcons PH (FLCN), 4-2, in Sunday’s grand finals at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
